name: Harrisburg
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Harrisburg, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Harrisburg and Mount Pleasant, NC: the Harrisburg Park tree lighting and the Mount Pleasant parade and tree lighting.
lede: Harrisburg kicks off the season with a free tree lighting at Harrisburg Park, and neighboring Mount Pleasant answers the next day with a parade and tree lighting.
celebrates: The Town of Harrisburg holds its annual Christmas Tree Lighting at Harrisburg Park, 191 Sims Parkway, with craft vendors, food trucks and entertainment on the main stage. The next afternoon, Mount Pleasant hosts its Christmas Parade up East Franklin Street and its tree lighting at Town Hall. The Cabarrus County CVB lists both events among its holiday highlights, together with Concord and Kannapolis celebrations. Families who want more can drive to Kannapolis for the Celebration of Lights, with a train ride through the park, or to Concord for Speedway Christmas.
lastyear: Last year's Harrisburg Christmas Tree Lighting also took place in Harrisburg Park, where the Cabarrus County CVB photographs the annual event each year, and Mount Pleasant's parade and tree lighting have long been paired on the first Saturday of December. This year the visitor bureau lists Harrisburg's lighting on December 4 and Mount Pleasant's parade and lighting on December 5, so a family can attend both on a single weekend.
facts: Cabarrus County has five municipalities: the cities of Concord and Kannapolis and the towns of Harrisburg, Midland and Mount Pleasant, according to the county CVB. The county sits about 30 minutes north of Charlotte. Harrisburg Park's tree lighting is listed as free, and Mount Pleasant's parade and tree lighting are listed as free too, on the Explore Cabarrus calendar.
trains: Harrisburg has no train ride of its own on our list. The nearest holiday trains are the Winterland Express rides at Village Park in Kannapolis, which cost $2.50 per person, and the model train display at the Swanee Theatre in Kannapolis on December 11 to 13, which is free. THE POLAR EXPRESS runs at the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer, in neighboring Rowan County.
train_links: Train rides and, at Christmas, THE POLAR EXPRESS at the old Spencer Shops.
traditions: A free evening at Harrisburg Park with craft vendors, food trucks and main stage entertainment.
A free downtown parade up East Franklin Street.
A tree lighting at Town Hall with seasonal entertainment.
A nearby light display with a train ride, open nightly through December 30.
kidfact: Cabarrus County has only five towns and cities, and Harrisburg and Mount Pleasant are two of them.
faq: When is the Harrisburg Christmas Tree Lighting?
Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6 to 8:30 pm at Harrisburg Park, 191 Sims Parkway. It is free, with craft vendors, food trucks and entertainment on the main stage.
Is there a Mount Pleasant Christmas parade?
Yes. The Town of Mount Pleasant holds its Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 3:30 pm, and the tree lighting at Town Hall follows at 5:30 pm.
Where can kids ride a Christmas train near Harrisburg?
The closest is the Winterland Express in Kannapolis's Village Park, with tickets at $2.50 per person. THE POLAR EXPRESS runs farther away in Spencer.
Yes. Explore Cabarrus lists the Harrisburg tree lighting and the Mount Pleasant parade as free.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Harrisburg for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, both of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Town of Harrisburg Christmas Tree Lighting) through December 5 (Mount Pleasant Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Harrisburg

  • 2 Christmas events for kids in Harrisburg
  • 2 free events: the Harrisburg Christmas Tree Lighting and the Mount Pleasant parade and tree lighting
  • Parades and tree lightings: Harrisburg Park on December 4 and downtown Mount Pleasant on December 5
  • Season: December 4, 2026 to December 5, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Harrisburg families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Charlotte, which covers Christmas Town U.S.A. in McAdenville, Winterfest at Carowinds, the Nutcracker at Belk Theater and Light the Knights at Truist Field.
